# Automated Reviews

Human-readable context for each review type. Scoring dimensions, weights, section mappings, diagram requirements, and AI evaluation/output instructions are defined in the **processing rules files** — the single source of truth. Each requirements doc links to its corresponding rules file.

## Adding a New Review Type

See [Adding a New Review Type](./adding-a-new-review-type.md) for the complete step-by-step guide.

> **Pass logic**: Overall weighted score only — individual dimension failures do NOT reject the submission.

## Updating Review Rules

1. Edit the processing rules JSON file (`resources/processing-rules/{type}-rules.json`)
2. Push changes — the deploy pipeline automatically syncs rules to S3 and invalidates the Redis cache after each deployment.
